name: tokentv
description: Your TokenTV desk clock shows Clawd raising a hand while Claude Code waits for your permission, a bow when a turn is done, a courtroom for a risky command, a ghost for a deleted file, its back turned for a rude prompt, dizzy after a failed tool and Claude Code's thinking word; /tokentv pet, snack and sound on|off. Tells the TokenTV on this computer the moment's name, nothing else.
